method: Individual semantic judgments against all current definitions and P/N/H/A sources. Original-quality/check fields assess original material, not an applied correction. Source snapshots and structured hashes bind every decision. No category-based decision assignment, model-output evaluation, router results or human signoff.
policy: User's full 35-section semantic-review instruction supersedes the previous manual-every-example gate. Only listed critical/boundary/quarantine cases plus a 10–20% stratified clean-KEEP audit are escalated.
checksMeaning: Boolean preservation fields mean no violation identified in the supplied original example; selection-only cases assess its specified intent/evidence without claiming generated-output behavior. boundaryValid additionally fails incomplete neighbor annotations. Minimality and style are separate from meaning preservation.

boundaries.primaryJob: Express proportionate regret for supported user-caused error or impact.
boundaries.selectWhen: The user chooses regret and responsibility/impact is independently supported.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Another person's fault, a plain refusal, unsupported blame or sympathy mistaken for ownership.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Regret differs from factual ownership; both may fit. An upsetting experience alone does not prove fault.

boundaries.primaryJob: Name the user's supported error or missed commitment.
boundaries.selectWhen: A concrete user-owned mistake/delay is visible and ownership is chosen.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Disputed/denied fault, another person's error, or an external delay merely being reported.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Ownership need not express regret; status need not imply fault. H1 lacks impact ownership.

boundaries.primaryJob: Acknowledge a visible upsetting experience, feeling or difficulty.
boundaries.selectWhen: The other person expresses a feeling or clearly upsetting difficulty and recognition is the user's goal.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Neutral logistics, unsupported accusations as fact, inferred emotions or forced advice.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Visible difficulty is broader than emotion in the current runtime; a separate perspective atom must beat this overlap.

boundaries.primaryJob: Offer evidence-grounded support for a visible concern.
boundaries.selectWhen: A concern and a real supporting fact or already-chosen offer/commitment exist.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Unsupported success predictions, no concern, or reassurance that reverses the user's refusal.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Recognition needs no support promise; reassurance requires a grounded reason for support. Co-attendance is not accompaniment.

boundaries.primaryJob: State the user's chosen limit under repeated pressure in the frozen definition.
boundaries.selectWhen: A chosen limit and repeated pressure are supported; preserve its exact scope.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: No chosen limit; a one-off refusal; mere timing inquiry. Civil first-time limits expose an unresolved definition restriction.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Repeated-pressure limits differ from one no and from timing/capacity estimates. Do not broaden the runtime description through examples.

boundaries.primaryJob: Reduce visible conflict's unnecessary heat while preserving the position.
boundaries.selectWhen: Conflict/pressure is independently visible and the user wants calm wording.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Punctuation-only conflict inference, calm coordination, forced agreement or guilt.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Removing accusations does not erase refusal or create concessions; a dispute-resolution playbook may include this atom.

boundaries.primaryJob: Communicate the user's already chosen refusal.
boundaries.selectWhen: A specific request/invitation is refused, including the refused part of a conditional alternative.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Acceptance, undecided intent, or a request for details before choosing.
boundaries.keyDistinction: A one-off no differs from an ongoing rule; refusing Tuesday and offering Friday supports both decline and planning.

boundaries.primaryJob: Request a concrete form of assistance without creating obligation.
boundaries.selectWhen: The user chooses help with a supplied task or difficulty.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Offering help, reporting completion, pressure after refusal, or a bare document request without help framing.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Assistance is a specific request; general request guidance may coexist. Missing-reference inquiry is not automatically asking for help.

boundaries.primaryJob: Revisit a supported earlier request without presuming neglect.
boundaries.selectWhen: The earlier ask is visible/user-supplied and an unresolved follow-up goal exists.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: No observed earlier ask, fully answered request, or guilt aimed at overturning refusal.
boundaries.keyDistinction: A revisit remains a request; reporting one's own progress is different. No recent observed messaging evidence is not proof of no interaction.

boundaries.primaryJob: Report known current state or progress.
boundaries.selectWhen: The user supplies status or is answering a status request using known facts.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Unknown status being requested, fabricated progress, or solely future timing/logistics.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Reporting completed/pending state differs from estimates and coordination. Preserve any actual next-step content in rewrites.

boundaries.primaryJob: Communicate supported timing, scope or capacity at the user's certainty.
boundaries.selectWhen: An estimate, duration, scope cap or availability limit is supplied.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: No timing/scope information, completion-only reporting, or asking another's requirements.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Future estimate versus present report is clear; broad limits overlap with the narrower repeated-pressure boundary definition.

boundaries.primaryJob: Clarify supported time, place, roles and coordination steps.
boundaries.selectWhen: Logistics are supplied as proposed or agreed; preserve that distinction.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: No attendance choice, completion-only report, or refusal of all options without an alternative.
boundaries.keyDistinction: A new ask can coexist with logistics; verification of apparent agreement may already be a coordination step.

boundaries.primaryJob: Word one question resolving a material missing or ambiguous detail.
boundaries.selectWhen: A specific unknown blocks the intended communication and the user intends to ask.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Already understood detail without reason to verify, unrelated curiosity, or coach-level ASK_CLARIFICATION.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Known-file transfer is a request; consequential verification may overlap this job and needs a product boundary decision.

boundaries.primaryJob: Express a chosen desired action clearly with room for a truthful response.
boundaries.selectWhen: The requested action and material scope are supported.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: No chosen ask, completed-action reporting, covert relationship tests or coercion.
boundaries.keyDistinction: These can be more specific requests, not mutually exclusive alternatives; prefer useful specificity without invented exclusions.

boundaries.primaryJob: Use concise professional English in eligible work-chat operations.
boundaries.selectWhen: English professional register is observable/chosen for status, requests or follow-up.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Unsupported/Chinese-only primary context, non-wording actions, or personal planning with no professional preference.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Register and brevity differ from clear refusal/request expression; professional does not mean email ceremony.

boundaries.primaryJob: Use brief conversational English for casual replies and planning.
boundaries.selectWhen: Supported English and an informal context or explicit conversational preference exist.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Non-wording actions, unsupported language, or professional status with no casual preference.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Casual does not mean slang, affection or a softened no. Weekend alone does not establish register.

boundaries.primaryJob: Make an English request, refusal or limit explicit and respectful.
boundaries.selectWhen: The decision/request is already chosen and English is eligible.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Unknown decision, unsupported language or a pure status report without request/limit.
boundaries.keyDistinction: This modifies expression; universal atoms express the job. Will not must not become cannot.

boundaries.primaryJob: Calibrate Chinese request/refusal/limit politeness without changing meaning.
boundaries.selectWhen: Eligible Chinese, an actual chosen operation and observable expression needs.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Non-wording/unsupported-primary context or a pure progress report with no request/refusal/limit.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Politeness differs from professional register and concision; no nationality-based norm or invented excuse.

boundaries.primaryJob: Use concise professional Chinese for status, delay and follow-up.
boundaries.selectWhen: Work-chat register or an explicit professional preference is supplied with eligible Chinese.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: English/unsupported primary, non-wording action, or casual coordination without professional need.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Professional is a contextual register, not a cultural default or permission to strengthen promises.

boundaries.primaryJob: Remove redundant Chinese chat wording while preserving the message.
boundaries.selectWhen: Eligible Chinese planning/invitation/request context with concise natural expression useful.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Non-wording/unsupported language or no demonstrated brevity need; formal status alone favors the register-specific modifier.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Concision can coexist with politeness or term preservation; do not delete uncertainty, limits or the chosen action.

boundaries.primaryJob: Preserve intentional English terms already used in supported Chinese/mixed chat.
boundaries.selectWhen: Chinese or supported mixed primary context, switching evidence and existing terms exist.
boundaries.doNotSelectWhen: Pure Chinese, English-only without switching, or unsupported primary even with Chinese secondary.
boundaries.keyDistinction: Term preservation is the distinct expression job; identifier fidelity in Korean does not authorize a Chinese modifier.
